```{r}
cosine_sparse <- function(bins1, values1, bins2, values2) {

  # Find bins that occur in both spectra
  matches <- match(bins1, bins2)
  keep <- !is.na(matches)

  # Calculate the dot product
  numerator <- sum(values1[keep] * values2[matches[keep]])

  # Calculate the lengths
  norm1 <- sqrt(sum(values1^2))
  norm2 <- sqrt(sum(values2^2))

  if (norm1 == 0 || norm2 == 0) {
    return(0)
  }

  return(numerator / (norm1 * norm2))
}
```

``{r}
search_spectrum <- function(query, reference, ppm = 20) {

  # Precursor mass filtering
  query_mz <- query$precursor_mz[1]
  query_adduct <- query$adduct[1]

  tolerance <- query_mz * ppm / 1000000

  lower <- query_mz - tolerance
  upper <- query_mz + tolerance

  keep <- which(
    reference$precursor_mz >= lower &
    reference$precursor_mz <= upper &
    reference$adduct == query_adduct
  )

  candidates <- reference[keep, ]

  # Return empty predictions if no candidates
  if (nrow(candidates) == 0) {
    return(data.frame(
      molecule = character(0),
      similarity = numeric(0)
    ))
  }

  # Calculate cosine similarities
  similarities <- numeric(nrow(candidates))

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(candidates))) {

    similarities[i] <- cosine_sparse(
      query$bins[[1]],
      query$bin_intensities[[1]],
      candidates$bins[[i]],
      candidates$bin_intensities[[i]]
    )
  }

  results <- data.frame(
    molecule = candidates$inchikey14,
    similarity = similarities
  )

  # Keep the best score for each molecule
  ranked <- aggregate(
    similarity ~ molecule,
    data = results,
    FUN = max
  )

  ranked <- ranked[order(-ranked$similarity), ]

  return(ranked)
}
``


``{r}
search_spectrum <- function(query, reference, ppm = 20, index = NULL) {

  # Precursor mass filtering
  query_mz <- query$precursor_mz[1]
  query_adduct <- query$adduct[1]

  tolerance <- query_mz * ppm / 1000000

  lower <- query_mz - tolerance
  upper <- query_mz + tolerance

  # Use the mass index if available
  if (!is.null(index)) {

    mass_bins <- seq(floor(lower), floor(upper))
    keys <- paste(query_adduct, mass_bins)

    rows <- unlist(index[keys], use.names = FALSE)

    reference <- reference[as.integer(rows), ]
  }

  # Apply exact mass and adduct filtering
  keep <- which(
    reference$precursor_mz >= lower &
    reference$precursor_mz <= upper &
    reference$adduct == query_adduct
  )

  candidates <- reference[keep, ]

  # Return empty results if there are no candidates
  if (nrow(candidates) == 0) {
    return(data.frame(
      molecule = character(0),
      similarity = numeric(0)
    ))
  }

  # Calculate cosine similarities
  similarities <- numeric(nrow(candidates))

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(candidates))) {

    similarities[i] <- cosine_sparse(
      query$bins[[1]],
      query$bin_intensities[[1]],
      candidates$bins[[i]],
      candidates$bin_intensities[[i]]
    )
  }

  results <- data.frame(
    molecule = candidates$inchikey14,
    similarity = similarities
  )

  # Keep the best score for each molecule
  ranked <- aggregate(
    similarity ~ molecule,
    data = results,
    FUN = max
  )

  ranked <- ranked[order(-ranked$similarity), ]

  return(ranked)
}
``
```{r}
search_spectrum <- function(query, reference, ppm = 20, index = NULL) {

  query_mz <- query$precursor_mz[1]
  query_adduct <- query$adduct[1]

  tolerance <- query_mz * ppm / 1000000
  lower <- query_mz - tolerance
  upper <- query_mz + tolerance

  if (!is.null(index)) {
    keys <- paste(query_adduct, seq(floor(lower), floor(upper)))
    rows <- unlist(index[keys], use.names = FALSE)
    reference <- reference[as.integer(rows), ]
  }

  keep <- which(
    reference$precursor_mz >= lower &
    reference$precursor_mz <= upper &
    reference$adduct == query_adduct
  )

  candidates <- reference[keep, ]

  if (nrow(candidates) == 0) {
    return(data.frame(molecule = character(0),
                      similarity = numeric(0)))
  }

  similarities <- numeric(nrow(candidates))

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(candidates))) {
    similarities[i] <- cosine_sparse(
      query$bins[[1]],
      query$bin_intensities[[1]],
      candidates$bins[[i]],
      candidates$bin_intensities[[i]]
    )
  }

  results <- data.frame(
    molecule = candidates$inchikey14,
    similarity = similarities
  )

  ranked <- aggregate(similarity ~ molecule,
                      data = results, FUN = max)

  ranked <- ranked[order(-ranked$similarity), ]

  return(ranked)
}
```

``{r}
search_molecule <- function(queries, reference, ppm = 20) {

  all_results <- list()

  # Search using each spectrum of the query molecule
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(queries))) {

    all_results[[i]] <- search_spectrum(
      queries[i, ],
      reference,
      ppm
    )

  }

  # Combine the results
  combined <- do.call(rbind, all_results)

  if (nrow(combined) == 0) {
    return(combined)
  }

  # Keep the maximum similarity for each candidate
  ranked <- aggregate(
    similarity ~ molecule,
    data = combined,
    FUN = max
  )

  ranked <- ranked[order(-ranked$similarity), ]

  return(ranked)
}
``

```{r}
reciprocal_rank <- function(ranked, true_molecule) {

  position <- match(true_molecule, ranked$molecule)

  if (is.na(position)) {
    return(0)
  }

  correct_score <- ranked$similarity[position]

  # Count candidates with higher and equal scores
  higher <- sum(ranked$similarity > correct_score)
  tied <- sum(ranked$similarity == correct_score)

  # Possible ranks if ties are broken randomly
  ranks <- seq(higher + 1, higher + tied)

  scores <- ifelse(ranks <= 25, 1 / ranks, 0)

  return(mean(scores))
}
```

``{r}
evaluate_baseline <- function(reference, ppm = 20) {

  ids <- names(query_groups)

  rr <- numeric(length(ids))

  for (i in seq_along(ids)) {

    id <- ids[i]

    queries <- val_spectra[query_groups[[id]], ]

    ranked_query <- search_molecule(
      queries,
      reference,
      ppm
    )

    rr[i] <- reciprocal_rank(ranked_query, id)

  }

  covered <- ids %in% reference$inchikey14

  results <- data.frame(
    molecule = ids,
    covered = covered,
    reciprocal_rank = rr
  )

  return(results)
}
``

```{r}
get_reference <- function(fraction) {

  ids <- molecules$inchikey14[
    which(molecules$train_subset_rank < fraction)
  ]

  reference <- train |>
    dplyr::filter(inchikey14 %in% ids) |>
    dplyr::select(
      row_id,
      inchikey14,
      precursor_mz,
      adduct,
      bins,
      bin_intensities
    ) |>
    dplyr::collect()

  return(reference)
}
```

```{r}
make_mass_index <- function(reference) {

  # Group spectra into 1 Da mass buckets
  mass_bin <- floor(reference$precursor_mz)

  # Combine adduct and mass bucket
  keys <- paste(reference$adduct, mass_bin)

  # Store the row numbers belonging to each bucket
  index <- split(seq_len(nrow(reference)), keys)

  return(index)
}
```

```{r}
run_experiment <- function(reference, fraction) {

  # Measure index construction time
  build_time <- system.time({
    index <- make_mass_index(reference)
  })

  # Measure search time
  search_time <- system.time({
    results <- evaluate_baseline(
      reference,
      index = index
    )
  })

  # Calculate bootstrap confidence interval
  set.seed(42)

  boot <- replicate(2000, {
    mean(sample(results$reciprocal_rank,
                replace = TRUE))
  })

  ci <- quantile(boot, c(0.025, 0.975))

  # Summarise the experiment
  summary <- data.frame(
    fraction = fraction,
    spectra = nrow(reference),
    molecules = length(unique(reference$inchikey14)),
    coverage = mean(results$covered),
    MRR = mean(results$reciprocal_rank),
    conditional_MRR = mean(
      results$reciprocal_rank[results$covered]
    ),
    CI_lower = as.numeric(ci[1]),
    CI_upper = as.numeric(ci[2]),
    build_seconds = as.numeric(build_time["elapsed"]),
    search_seconds = as.numeric(search_time["elapsed"]),
    memory_MB = as.numeric(object.size(reference)) / 1024^2,
    index_MB = as.numeric(object.size(index)) / 1024^2
  )

  return(list(summary = summary, results = results))
}
```

```{r}
compare_search <- function(fraction, repeats = 3) {

  reference <- get_reference(fraction)
  index <- make_mass_index(reference)

  ordinary_times <- numeric(repeats)
  indexed_times <- numeric(repeats)
  same_results <- logical(repeats)

  for (i in seq_len(repeats)) {

    ordinary_times[i] <- system.time({
      ordinary <- evaluate_baseline(reference)
    })["elapsed"]

    indexed_times[i] <- system.time({
      indexed <- evaluate_baseline(
        reference,
        index = index
      )
    })["elapsed"]

    same_results[i] <- isTRUE(all.equal(
      ordinary$reciprocal_rank,
      indexed$reciprocal_rank
    ))
  }

  data.frame(
    fraction = fraction,
    spectra = nrow(reference),
    ordinary_seconds = median(ordinary_times),
    indexed_seconds = median(indexed_times),
    speedup = median(ordinary_times) /
              median(indexed_times),
    identical_results = all(same_results)
  )
}
```

```{r}
evaluate_shared <- function(reference, validation,
                            ppm = 20) {

  # Identify molecules represented in the reference library
  known <- validation$inchikey14 %in%
    reference$inchikey14

  # Create and time the mass index
  build_time <- system.time({
    index <- make_mass_index(reference)
  })

  # Store the results for each validation spectrum
  n <- nrow(validation)

  top1 <- numeric(n)
  top5 <- numeric(n)
  top25 <- numeric(n)
  rr <- numeric(n)
  rr_ties <- numeric(n)

  n_candidates <- integer(n)
  correct_candidate <- logical(n)
  predictions <- character(n)

  # Search for each validation spectrum separately
  search_time <- system.time({

    for (i in seq_len(n)) {

      query <- validation[i, ]

      if (!is.finite(query$precursor_mz[1]) ||
          is.na(query$adduct[1])) {
        next
      }

      ranked <- search_spectrum(
        query,
        reference,
        ppm = ppm,
        index = index
      )

      # Use molecule identifiers to break similarity ties
      ranked <- ranked[
        order(-ranked$similarity,
              ranked$molecule,
              method = "radix"),
      ]

      true_molecule <- validation$inchikey14[i]

      position <- match(
        true_molecule,
        ranked$molecule
      )

      n_candidates[i] <- nrow(ranked)

      predictions[i] <- paste(
        head(ranked$molecule, 25),
        collapse = ";"
      )

      # Check whether the correct molecule was a candidate
      correct_candidate[i] <- !is.na(position)

      if (!is.na(position)) {

        top1[i] <- as.numeric(position <= 1)
        top5[i] <- as.numeric(position <= 5)
        top25[i] <- as.numeric(position <= 25)

        if (position <= 25) {
          rr[i] <- 1 / position
        }

        rr_ties[i] <- reciprocal_rank(
          ranked,
          true_molecule
        )
      }
    }
  })

  results <- data.frame(
    row_id = validation$row_id,
    source_part = validation$source_part,
    molecule = validation$inchikey14,
    known = known,
    n_candidates = n_candidates,
    correct_candidate = correct_candidate,
    predicted_top25 = predictions,
    top1 = top1,
    top5 = top5,
    top25 = top25,
    MRR = rr,
    MRR_ties = rr_ties
  )

  return(list(
    results = results,
    reference_spectra = nrow(reference),
    reference_molecules = length(
      unique(reference$inchikey14)
    ),
    build_seconds = as.numeric(build_time["elapsed"]),
    search_seconds = as.numeric(search_time["elapsed"])
  ))
}
```

```{r}
summarise_shared <- function(experiment, keep, population) {

  results <- experiment$results[keep, ]

  data.frame(
    population = population,
    n = nrow(results),
    coverage = mean(results$known),

    candidate_coverage = mean(
      results$correct_candidate
    ),

    top1 = mean(results$top1),
    top5 = mean(results$top5),
    top25 = mean(results$top25),
    MRR = mean(results$MRR),
    MRR_ties = mean(results$MRR_ties),

    reference_spectra = experiment$reference_spectra,
    reference_molecules = experiment$reference_molecules,

    index_seconds = experiment$build_seconds,
    search_seconds_all = experiment$search_seconds
  )
}
```


```{r}
shared_summary_100 <- rbind(

  summarise_shared(
    shared_experiment_100,
    rep(TRUE, nrow(shared_val)),
    "All validation"
  ),

  summarise_shared(
    shared_experiment_100,
    known_100,
    "Known molecules at 100%"
  ),

  summarise_shared(
    shared_experiment_100,
    known_5,
    "Fixed 5% known molecules"
  )
)

shared_summary_100
```

```{r}
shared_scaling <- rbind(

  shared_summary_5[2, ],

  shared_summary_9[3, ],

  shared_summary_100[3, ]
)

shared_scaling$fraction <- c(0.05, 0.09, 1)

shared_scaling[, c(
  "fraction",
  "reference_spectra",
  "n",
  "candidate_coverage",
  "top1",
  "top5",
  "top25",
  "MRR_ties",
  "index_seconds",
  "search_seconds_all"
)]
```

```{r}
shared_scaling$conditional_top1 <-
  shared_scaling$top1 /
  shared_scaling$candidate_coverage

shared_scaling$conditional_MRR <-
  shared_scaling$MRR_ties /
  shared_scaling$candidate_coverage

shared_scaling[, c(
  "fraction",
  "candidate_coverage",
  "top1",
  "conditional_top1",
  "MRR_ties",
  "conditional_MRR"
)]
```

```{r}
plot(
  shared_scaling$fraction * 100,
  shared_scaling$candidate_coverage,
  type = "b",
  pch = 19,
  col = "black",
  ylim = c(0, 1),
  xlab = "Dataset split (%)",
  ylab = "Proportion",
  main = "Candidate coverage and identification performance"
)

lines(
  shared_scaling$fraction * 100,
  shared_scaling$top1,
  type = "b",
  pch = 19,
  col = "steelblue"
)

lines(
  shared_scaling$fraction * 100,
  shared_scaling$conditional_top1,
  type = "b",
  pch = 19,
  col = "darkgreen"
)

legend(
  "bottomright",
  legend = c(
    "Candidate coverage",
    "Top-1 accuracy",
    "Conditional top-1 accuracy"
  ),
  col = c("black", "steelblue", "darkgreen"),
  lty = 1,
  pch = 19
)
```

```{r}
write.csv(
  shared_summary_100,
  file.path(output_dir, "shared_100pct_summary.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  shared_experiment_100$results,
  file.path(output_dir, "shared_100pct_predictions.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  shared_scaling,
  file.path(output_dir, "shared_scaling.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```
